question: Identify the wrong pair of ports and their state from the following?
solution:
The correct answer is **__New Mangalore Port-Andhra Pradesh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Major ports of India: **Kolkata, Paradip, Vishakhapatnam, Kamarajar, Chennai, Tuticorin, Cochin, New Mangalore, Mormugao, Mumbai, Jawaharlal Nehru (Maharashtra), Kandla, and Port Blair.
 
• The 13 major ports of India handle **more than 95 percent of our foreign trade by volume and 65 percent by value.**
 
• **Syama Prasad Mookarjee port trust, Kolkata **is the **oldest port** in India.
 
• **Ennore port **is the **only port owned by the private sector** among 13 major ports.

 
 

 **Major Ports of India**
 **Salient Features**
 
 

 **New Mangalore Port, Karnataka**
 
 
 
• Located at the confluence of **river Gurupura and the Arabian sea.**
 
• The only major port in Karnataka.
 
• **7th largest port** in the country.
 
• **Major products:** Petroleum, fertilizers, iron ore, etc
 
 
 
 

 Mormugao Port, Goa
 
 
 
• Located in the estuaries of **river Juari.**
 
• Leading** iron ore exporter **in India.
 
 
 
 

 Kandla Port, Gujarat
 
 
 
• Also known as **Deendayal port.**
 
• Situated 90km away from the **Gulf of Kutch.**
 
• **The largest port **on the basis of **volume.**
 
 
 
 

 Tuticorin Port, Tamil Nadu
 
 
 
• It is an artificial port.
 
• Also known as **V.O. Chidambaranar port.**
 
• 4th largest terminal container in India.
